name: Pension Adelheid
beschreibung: Pension Adelheid is a family-run hotel in a quiet location in a mountain village in Tirol. The surroundings are ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The rooms are furnished in traditional style and have a balcony and free Wi-Fi. Amenities also include a garden and a ski cellar. The atmosphere is personal and cozy. The accommodation is aimed at couples and families who appreciate a quiet environment. For dining, a breakfast buffet is offered; on request, half board with regional dishes can be booked.
